summary.en: Ran tells Conan that Shuichi Akai is an FBI agent causing Conan to wonder what the FBI are doing in Japan. Conan heads to Professor Agasa to analyze the data from Suguru Itakura's disk and learn that the Black Organization were going to Itakura's cottage to retrieve the program he was working on. Conan and Professor Agasa head to Itakura's cottage in an attempt to intercept the email the Black Organization would send in order to trace them. However, the email was programmed to be deleted if the correct password was not typed and subsequently causes the Black Organization members to believe Itakura is in the cottage. Vodka phones the house and believing Itakura is in the cottage, to pick up the phone.
summary.zhHans: 柯南与黑衣组织的接触线继续推进，谈判、追踪和决死行动交替出现，具体案件边界待拆分。
